mapper.sql: id, elderly_user_id, role, name, phone, open_id, caregiver_id, notify_enabled, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO family_bind (elderly_user_id, role, name, phone, open_id, caregiver_id, notify_enabled, create_time) VALUES (#{elderlyUserId}, #{role}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{openId}, #{caregiverId}, IFNULL(#{notifyEnabled}, 1), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE family_bind SET open_id = #{openId}, notify_enabled = IFNULL(#{notifyEnabled}, notify_enabled) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM family_bind WHERE elderly_user_id = #{elderlyUserId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM family_bind WHERE elderly_user_id = #{elderlyUserId} AND IFNULL(notify_enabled, 1) = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT b.id, b.elderly_user_id, b.role, b.name, b.phone, b.open_id, b.caregiver_id, b.notify_enabled, b.create_time, u.name AS elderly_name, u.address AS elderly_address FROM family_bind b LEFT JOIN elderly_user u ON u.id = b.elderly_user_id WHERE b.open_id = #{openId} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.elderly_user_id, b.role, b.name, b.phone, b.open_id, b.caregiver_id, b.notify_enabled, b.create_time, u.name AS elderly_name, u.address AS elderly_address FROM family_bind b LEFT JOIN elderly_user u ON u.id = b.elderly_user_id WHERE b.caregiver_id = #{caregiverId} ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
